_comment: 24 eval cases (brief requires >=20: normal/edge/adversarial). 8 are EXPERT-WRITTEN by Maria and Ghina in their own clusters - the only queries here not authored by a developer. 2 are marked known_fail: Arabizi is misrouted as English by design-level limitation, kept in the set deliberately so the failure is MEASURED rather than hidden.

cases.note: EXPECTATION CHANGED 2026-07-28 (was service_not_found). Passport is still absent from Dawlati — report §2 stands unchanged. What changed is that the external-source branch answers it from the issuing authority's own site, so abstaining is no longer the best available response and scoring against it would penalise a behaviour we deliberately replaced. edge_absent_2 (driving licence) and edge_absent_3 (not a government service) still expect service_not_found — no curated source exists for either, so they keep guarding the abstention path.
